```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list = ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(jsonlite)
library(visNetwork)

source("../code/cleaning_functions.R")
```

# Belmonte

```{r raw-graph-creation-belmonte, echo = FALSE}
temp <- load.graphs(theory = "Belmonte")
invisible(list2env(temp, envir = .GlobalEnv))

```

### Node Mappings for Belmonte

```{r node-map-belmonte, echo = F}

knitr::kable((data.frame(umbrella_name = unname(node_map), original_name = names(node_map))))

```



### S Raw Graph

```{r plot.s.raw.belmonte, echo = F}
g <- s.raw

is_dag(g)
feedback_arc_set(g)

nodes <- data.frame(id = V(g)$name, label = V(g)$name)

edges <- as_data_frame(g, what = "edges") %>% 
  drop_cycles_for_visnetwork() 

visNetwork(nodes, edges) %>%
  visHierarchicalLayout(direction = "LR", sortMethod = "directed") %>%  # left-to-right DAG
  visInteraction(navigationButtons = TRUE) %>% 
  visEdges(arrows = "to")

```
```{r is.dag.s.raw.belmonte}
is_dag(g)
feedback_arc_set(g)
```

### Node Frequency Table

```{r node-freq-belmonte, echo = F}
s.nodes <- data.frame(node = unique(c(s.clean$to, s.clean$from)), graph = "s")
j.nodes <- data.frame(node = unique(c(j.clean$to, j.clean$from)), graph = "j")
gpt.nodes <- data.frame(node = unique(c(gpt.clean$to, gpt.clean$from)), graph = "gpt")
gemini.nodes <- data.frame(node = unique(c(gemini.clean$to, gemini.clean$from)), graph = "gemini")

combined.nodes <- s.nodes %>% bind_rows(j.nodes, gemini.nodes, gpt.nodes)


freq.table <- combined.nodes %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = graph,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>% 
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(s:gpt))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(total))


knitr::kable(freq.table)
```
